question: What saturation and remanent magnetization did the Ni–Ag/rGO catalyst for 4-nitrophenol reduction have?
rendered: According to the document, the Ni–Ag/rGO catalyst for 4-nitrophenol reduction had a saturation magnetization (Ms) of 11.10 emu per g and a remanent magnetization (Mr) of 2.47 emu per g.
